decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is competitive but complements the business communications portfolio; keep for now.
Specific adoption as a data centre connection network in Hong Kong shows market traction and strategic value.
Optical spectrum connectivity has its own page, indicating strategic focus and investment.
Voice number ordering portal likely supports digital customer experience but has limited standalone traction.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy service with limited future demand.
Direct voice network connection aligns with modern business voice needs.
